facts.fact: Infervision, a vendor, says that since 2024 Zimbabwe's Ministry of Health and Child Care has used its InferRead AI chest X-ray reading with InferAir portable X-ray in a TB screening project in Gweru, with over 2,600 people screened daily.

systems.platform: AI chest X-ray computer-aided detection with portable X-ray
systems.owner: Infervision with the Ministry of Health and Child Care
